inputs.sequence_prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Continue the SAME live-action fight and the carried forward punch. Goku is LEFT, Vegeta RIGHT, in the same warm dry rocky canyon and daylight. The red KAIOKEN is ALREADY ACTIVE on Goku. Persistent <Picture 1> is the original identity reference, not a request to reset the opening pose or turn the aura off. Preserve the EXACT original two adult human actors: taller athletic East Asian Goku, asymmetrical black hair and original face, orange heavy cotton gi with Turtle insignia, navy undershirt/sash/wristbands and navy boots; shorter compact Vegeta, same sharp face and widow's peak/upright black hair, royal-blue bodysuit, white armor with ochre ribbed panels and raised shoulder/hip guards, white gloves, white/gold boots and brown tail around his waist. Keep human skin, faces, body proportions, fabric and armor unchanged. No blonde hair, new transformation, new damage or extra people.

STORY: Goku INCREASES his existing Kaioken, overwhelms Vegeta and KICKS HIM FAR AWAY toward the mountain on SCREEN RIGHT. The ten seconds contain a short attacking combination followed by a clear airborne consequence, not ten seconds of stationary sparring.

During the opening continued punch Goku's existing CRIMSON aura gives one brief stronger pressure pulse. Loose dust pushes outward from his planted boots and his gi flutters, but his actual body, face and black hair remain the same. Increase energy intensity, not muscle size. He does not stop to pose or charge. Vegeta sees the increased force, eyes widening slightly as he tries to tighten his guard. Energy remains on GOKU ONLY, transparent enough to see face, fists, feet and contacts.

First roughly two seconds: Goku drives a compact RIGHT cross through Vegeta's high guard, snaps the fist clear and follows with a LEFT hook to the ribs. Vegeta's guard is knocked aside, his shoulder and hips are displaced backward, his trunk folds after the hook. His rear boot lifts and lands farther back, then the front boot follows in a SECOND hurried catching step. Goku walks into the ground Vegeta just lost, continuing to attack during those recovery steps. Make the bodies actually travel across the canyon ground rather than rocking at fixed marks.

Around2.5-3.5seconds Goku pivots on his loaded LEFT support boot and whips a short RIGHT low round kick across Vegeta's forward thigh. The shin strikes once and immediately clears, right knee folds back and the boot lands. Vegeta's hit leg buckles and his hips drop sideways AFTER the shin arrives; he scrambles a further step backward. Goku immediately closes the distance with one sharp LEFT jab, opening Vegeta's guard. Fast punch-kick combination, immediate retractions, no alternating equal trade.

Around4.5-6seconds Goku commits the FINISHING KICK. He plants his LEFT boot solidly, rotates hips and torso, lifts the RIGHT knee and drives one explosive RIGHT roundhouse into the SIDE of Vegeta's torso armor. Show the actual shin/boot hit the torso; Vegeta's head, shoulders and pelvis are driven to SCREEN RIGHT by that single impact. Goku immediately refolds the knee and pulls his leg completely away, setting his right boot back on the ground. He does not hold the foot against Vegeta, grab him or jump with him.

ONLY AFTER that impact, Vegeta LOSES HIS ENTIRE BASE: both white boots leave the ground, his torso folds then extends with the momentum and he is hurled several body lengths AWAY to SCREEN RIGHT, diagonally upward across the open canyon. He is the SAME armored man throughout, not a replacement stunt figure. Arms and boots trail his accelerated torso. His inability to stop is involuntary recoil, not a self-powered jump or voluntary flight. Goku stays on the ground at LEFT with his red aura while Vegeta rapidly separates from him.

Final roughly four seconds: follow the airborne Vegeta in one continuous motivated RIGHTWARD pan and smooth widening. His whole body travels through a continuous shallow ballistic arc, with downward acceleration beginning after the rise; no hovering. The growing gap and the static canyon landmarks prove the displacement. Keep his full armored body legible, boots and tail trailing. The existing distant rocky mountain on the RIGHT lies ahead along the SAME flight vector. End WHILE Vegeta is still traveling toward that rock face, before the mountain collision. That collision and Galick Gun belong to the next take. Do not reset Vegeta onto his feet or return to sparring.

Normal speed, fast compact strikes with short contacts and complete limb retractions. The receiver keeps recoiling after separation. Grounded support soles transfer force through the hips; catching steps lift and land, without rigid foot sliding. Human photorealism with owner-directed superhuman Kaioken force. One unbroken medium-wide three-quarter side shot shows both bodies and support feet during the combo; only widen and pan right as the final impact launches Vegeta. Same canyon axis and daylight. No cuts, freeze, slow motion, retiming, orbit, shake hiding the contact, opaque red wash, blood, beam, Galick Gun, Kamehameha or mountain crash in this shot.

overall_soundscape: Short synchronized punch and kick impacts, urgent recovery footfalls, cloth, canyon wind, a brief stronger low Kaioken pressure pulse on Goku and a heavy air rush after Vegeta is launched. No speech, voices, screams, grunts or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.
